newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes close down, grades dragged lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes close down, grades dragged lower.

text.p: Sharp losses in the NYMEX heating oil market pulled crude prices lower Thursday, leaving U.S. cash values to follow a downward path, traders said.
Outright values were stuck in ranges all session, but eventually pushed lower by the close.
Grade differentials did most of their movement in the morning, when sweet and sour grades furthered the recent trend for weakening differentials to the West Texas Intermediate/Cushing benchmark.
Feb WTI ended around 50 cents lower at $25.40-50 a barrel, and the Feb/WTI wound up around 70 cts.
